item.title: Sisters Novitiate is coming to Darktide on December 7th!
item.description:
Heresy Shall Be Met With Fire and Righteous Wrath as the Sisters Novitiate Arrive in Warhammer 40,000: Darktide on December 7th!

Warband! 

The Adepta Sororitas will make their presence known on Tertium, with the Sisters Novitiate class launching into Warhammer 40,000: Darktide with fervour and fury. Wielding a devastating arsenal of weaponry and channelling their unwavering faith through a unique talent system, these zealous warriors will come thundering into the Hive ready to prove their mettle in the Emperor’s name! 

The Sisters Novitiate Class will launch alongside a free update introducing the long-anticipated Meltagun to Darktide! The iconic Warhammer 40,000 weapon can be wielded by both the Sisters Novitiate and the Veteran class.

The Emperor Protects: Unlike other classes, the Sisters Novitiate are able to choose from six divine and devastating Acts of Faith, as opposed to blitz and combat abilities. Their abilities draw upon reserves of Faith, allowing them to unleash brutal Neural Whip attacks to the inspiring Icon of Purity and protective prayers. Faith can take many forms for the Sisters Novitiate, each channeling the Emperor's divine will and bringing his wrath upon his enemies.  

Faith must be proven, Sisters Novitiate build their reserves throughout combat, choosing from a range of Devotions and Pledges within their talent tree, each shaping how Faith is both accumulated and put to use.  Any two Acts of Faith can be equipped at a time, allowing players to choose how their Novitiate will unleash righteous fury on the battlefield.  

Arms of the Ecclesiarchy: Though still Novitiates of the Adepta Sororitas, these battle eager warriors have come to Tertium ready for war! Their arsenal is formidable, including the Condemnor Stakethrower - which pins what remains of their enemies to the walls. Alongside these they also carry the Ministorum Hand Flamer, Mace of the Righteous, Penitent Eviscerator and the Novitiate Sword and Shield. Whilst these weapons are unique to the Sisters Novitiate, they also wield the Meltagun, which is also accessible by Veterans. Different hands, same consecrated purpose.

United in Holy Battle: The Sisters Novitiate bring both support and frontline resilience to the war on Tertium. Built to fight alongside their allies, they can weather the thick of the battle while weakening enemies, controlling the battlefield and keeping their allies in the fray. Their strength lies in standing where they are needed most, disrupting the enemy and shaping the battlefield to their advantage. 

Sacred Beasts of Burden: The Sisters Novitiate Class Deluxe Edition unlocks the Cherub, a grotesque yet angelic accessory befitting the faithful servants of the God-Emperor. This unsettling mechanical companion flutters around the Sisters Novitiate as a purely cosmetic addition, accompanying them on their holy duty.

More Transmissions from the Hive: The December 7th Class release is accompanied by a free update. Introducing the Meltagun to the armories of Hive Tertium, wieldable by both Sisters Novitiate and the Veteran, the iconic weapon unleashes a devastating blast of thermal energy.  More information on the free update coming soon.

That’s all for today! In the coming days we will reveal more in our first Feature Highlight about the new class! 

The class releases on December 7th and you can wishlist it now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5026140http://store.steampowered.com/app/5026150

See you on the Mourningstar,

The Darktide Team

item.title: Special Live Event: The Grandfather's Gifts
item.description:
Warband!

Enemies have been imbued with foul warp energy, causing them to sprout tentacles. These enemies explode when shot in the head. Thankfully, Command has granted the Strike Team extra ammunition and grenades, as well as Incendiary Ammunition for these missions!

Starting today until November 26, complete missions with the ‘Mutated Horrors’ condition to make progress in the event!

The rewards will be Ordo dockets, Plasteel and Diamantine. Those who complete the last tier of the event will receive a cosmetic insignia.

item.title: Stella, Miraculist of the God-Emperor
item.description:
Her name is Stella.

Alabaster skin, a stoic posture, golden hair and the luminous eyes of a living statue.

Yet, this skin is covered by cracks, hard as marble and cold to the touch, and her eyes bleed when her powers manifest.

Is she a miracle of the Emperor? A martyr? A conduit of His will? Or do these signs betray her filthy mutant nature? This duality follows Stella throughout her entire life. She has never doubted her divine purpose, but for the Lord Captain, the answer is far more complicated.

Stella was still a child when Confessor Bernart of the Saint Cognatius Order of the Ecclesiarchy took her into his care, recognising her gift as a sign of the God-Emperor’s favour. Becoming as much her mentor as her warden, he personally oversaw her upbringing as a Miraculist — a living weapon of the Ecclesiarchy. Blessed with the gift of divination and the power to unleash purifying flames, she spent years accompanying the Confessor in his pilgrimages across the Koronus Expanse.

Her blazing aura would lend weight to Bernart’s sermons, her powers exposing heresy in all its forms. To the judgemental and uncompromising Bernart, she became an invaluable instrument for demonstrating the might of the Emperor and guiding the faith of His subjects. Ever grateful to the man who had raised her, Stella served with unwavering zeal, believing this to be her sacred calling and sole means of serving the God-Emperor.

There were, however, those who whispered of something sinister lurking within this woman. Of dark shadows passing across her eyes. Of fits of anger, of heretical markings upon her flesh. Of her collar that suggested that she posed a danger to those around. Some even dared to question her divine nature!

The Ecclesiarchy, of course, was always swift and merciless when dealing with such heretical suspicions.

These journeys spanned many years, but recently, something has changed. Stella was always capable of divinations, but never before have her visions been so detailed or so purposeful. They hint at a person of great wealth and influence, someone who will lead her to a place of unspeakable horrors to fulfill her destiny.

The hierarchs of the Order of the Saint Cognatius soon recognised these visions as a sign from the Emperor himself: a holy mission construed to the order. An expedition was assembled to seek out this mysterious figure — a planetary governor, perhaps, or an Imperial Fleet commander. And when they emerged from the warp storm in the same system as the von Valancius flagship, and discovered the Rogue Trader as the person foretold in Stella’s visions... what could this be, if not a miraculous intervention by the God-Emperor himself?

Will you allow them on your voidship and aid them in their mission, Lord Captain? Will you play the part foretold for you, as the God-Emperor wills, or exploit the situation to your own advantage? Will you seek the truth behind these events, or is it the spoils of the expedition and the riches of the void that you’re after?

Or could Stella herself become the greatest prize of all, one of the most valuable possessions of the von Valancius dynasty?

There is only one way to find out.

item.title: The PTS has officially reopened!
item.description:
Hi Space Marines! ⭐

The Public Test Server opens once more today! Jump in until Nov 18 and test the new content from the upcoming Patch 16. Check out this quick FAQ to help you get started and ready before launch.


‎

What’s a Public Test Server?

Space Marine 2’s Public Test Server works as a separate version of the game featuring WIP content and features. Share your feedback to help us refine the patch before its official release. Your input provides an important perspective that will be reviewed by the developer team and have an impact on further game updates.

Since this is a test environment, expect the unfinished content and possible bugs. As you will access it through a different game version, your progression will not be tracked. For each PTS update, you will land on the game with levels maxed out and all weapons unlocked.

Please note that the DLCs won’t be available, regardless of whether you own them.
‎
Since the PTS is "Public", you are free to create content based on it. No NDA will be included.

Which platforms can access the PTS?

The PTS is only available on PC via Steam. It is not accessible on consoles (PlayStation/Xbox) or through the Epic Games Store.

Now, let’s see how to install it 👇
‎

📝 Tutorial on how to access PTS via Steam:

Just follow these simple steps:

  1. Open the Steam client.

  2. Log in with the account that owns Space Marine 2.

  3. Go to your Steam Library.

  4. Look for “Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 - Public Test Server” under your Space Marine 2 entry.

  5. (Optional) Right-click on your Library entry and go to Properties. In the “General” tab, set the game’s default Language to “English”. Translations may still be work-in-progress when you try the new content out on the PTS. As a result, we recommend setting the game to English.

  6. Once you’ve clicked on this entry, install the Public Test Server content. This install instance is not related to the base game, your files will remain in separate directories and all future updates will also be distinct, meaning that your current progression will not be affected by the time you spend on the PTS.

When the install is complete, the Public Test Server is ready to launch!

Click “Play” like you would with any other game!

Can I try every single feature that will be implemented with the next Patch?

Most upcoming content will be available to you. However, we won’t share content that is too buggy or hasn’t undergone the necessary approvals on our side at the time of the PTS release.

Also, some content might be present on the PTS, but not accessible to the players. For instance, you may see new Champions in the Armouring Hall but won’t be able to try them unless you own the Season Pass.
‎

Will my progress be saved?

No, because the PTS runs as a completely separate game version. It does not carry over your previous progress in the game; instead, it provides all players with a default maxed-out level and weapons. This ensures that you won’t have to spend time to unlock all the features, especially the Prestige Ranks.

It will also not save your progress nor transfer it to the official game version afterwards.
‎

Is multiplayer available on the PTS?

Yes, even private PvP lobbies will work so you can invite your Brothers and Sisters to play!
‎

Do mods work with the PTS?

Mods won't work with the PTS. Enabling them will cause the PTS to crash at launch. Please, make sure to disable them beforehand.
‎

How can I give feedback?

We need your feedback!

As mentioned in previous Community Updates, the primary purpose of the Public Test Server is to gather your feedback on new content, changes, and balancing tweaks we plan to implement in the game.

We’ve set up dedicated forum threads on Focus Together to let you voice your opinion, which you can find here.

Thank you for helping us make Space Marine 2 the best it can be!

item.title: Processional of the Damned DLC is coming out on December 8!
item.description:
The release date for DLC4: Processional of the Damned has been announced! The final expansion for Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader unlocks on December 8 on PC and console.

Meet Stella the Miraculist, a living relic of the Ecclesiarchy. Trail her visions to a mysterious region of space known as the Processional of the Damned and explore a massive voidship graveyard orbiting a dying star. Uncover its secrets, discover its riches, and meet its uncanny denizens, walking a thin line between reality and madness.

Utilize the brand new Zealot archetype, equip your crew with grenade launchers, and emerge from this cursed place with immeasurable spoils — or succumb to insanity, dooming yourself and your crew to stay here forever.

Are you bold enough to see this to the end, Lord Captain?



https://store.steampowered.com/app/5247570/Warhammer_40000_Rogue_Trader__Processional_of_the_Damned/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3650060/Warhammer_40000_Rogue_Trader_Season_Pass_2/
